title: Dialog data
description:
Move data between a dialog's controls and a struct, checking it when OK is pressed.

```
load:  name "Ada", age 36, newsletter checked
user changes age to "abc" and presses OK
-> "Age must be a whole number from 1 to 130", focus on the age box, dialog stays open
fix it and press OK -> struct updated, dialog closes
```
hints: Build a new `Person` and return it only at the end, so a failure leaves the old one alone (lesson 3.01).
On an error, `SetFocus(GetDlgItem(dialog, error.control))` puts the user where the problem is.
requirements: Controls are a `std::map<int, std::string>` of control id to text, standing in for `GetDlgItemText`.
`toControls(data)` and `fromControls()` returning either the data or the first error with its control id.
Nothing in the struct changes unless every field is valid.
stretch: Check as the user types and enable OK only when everything is valid.
